adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies a test quality issue. Looking at the test in spec/controllers/embed_controller_spec.rb lines 8-11, the test 'is 404 without an embed_url' calls `get :best` without setting up embeddable_host or referer. The ensure_embeddable filter (lines 23-29 in embed_controller.rb) will reject the request before params.require(:embed_url) is reached because embeddable_host is blank. The test only checks `response.should_not be_success` which passes for any failure, not specifically for the missing embed_url parameter. This is a legitimate test coverage concern - the test doesn't actually verify the intended behavior (404 for missing embed_url parameter) because it fails earlier in the filter chain.
